scope: Current 70 first-status pages; small-column, band and adjacent-page boundaries whose following small run starts with 又 after trimming spaces. Large glyphs interrupt continuity. Punctuation/overlays are excluded using the production parser.

method.previousRunCapacity: Same parallel group: group height. Next band/page: page rowCap (24) minus previous group startRow plus 1.
method.missingPreviousTrailingSpace: Following run starts with 又, neither side records a space, previous run occupies fewer slots than capacity. Candidate only; check original scan.
method.semanticReview: Do not globally insert before 又; verify original blank and distinguish a glyph component from a new sense.
